ui.mode: Headless Chromium on the existing personal DSH; candidate factory replaced only in the QA page response, not on disk.

firstFailures.cause: Existing category-x uniqueness validation rejected duplicate labels.
firstFailures.fix: Keep the validator; retain original labels separately and use unique source record positions for canonical category x.

firstFailures.cause: Type narrowing and impossible union guards failed typecheck.
firstFailures.fix: Use an explicit never-returning function declaration and remove impossible guards.

firstFailures.cause: QA string replacement interpreted JavaScript replacement tokens inside the compiled candidate, corrupting the combo response.
firstFailures.fix: Use a replacement callback to insert literal candidate bytes; retain failed transfer evidence privately.

firstFailures.cause: Context and selected ECharts layers reused one series id; json-render caught the engine error and omitted the chart.
firstFailures.fix: Distinct application-owned layer IDs; actual SVG engine and UI regression passed.

firstFailures.cause: Narrow QA sidebar control changed during resize and an arbitrary width expectation exceeded the actual host container.
firstFailures.fix: Collapse before resize, record actual 231px container within 360px page, verify overflow and inspect screenshots; compact time ticks.

preservation.newExplorationStorage: current origin/browser local storage or explicit file export

adoption.reason: Existing Edge connections; local browser control disabled. DSH client HMR remounts components and draft state is unknown. Preserve existing page while preparing reviewable source and archive.

release.verification: GitHub uploaded asset sizes and SHA-256 metadata match local frozen files; no anonymous download matrix rerun.
